name: will
summary: Kelajakdagi taxminlar, va'dalar va shu paytda qabul qilingan qarorlar haqida gapirish uchun will so'zini ishlatamiz.

usage.text: Kelajak haqida o'z taxminimizni aytish uchun (ko'pincha I think bilan).

example.en: I think it will rain tomorrow.
I will help you with your homework.
example.uz: Senga uy vazifangni bajarishga yordam beraman.

usage.text: Gapirayotgan paytimizda qilingan birdan-bir qarorlar (spontaneous decisions) uchun.

example.en: It's cold here. I'll close the window.
example.uz: Bu yerda sovuq ekan. Men derazani yopaman.

example.en: She will come to the party.
Will you buy a new phone?

structure.formula: Yes, subject + will / No, subject + won't

example.en: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

tip: Eslatma: 'will' so'zidan keyin fe'l hech qanday qo'shimchalarsiz (V1 shaklida) keladi va barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil bo'ladi.

name: be going to
summary: Oldindan rejalashtirilgan ishlarimiz va ko'zimiz bilan ko'rib turgan dalillarga asoslangan kelajakdagi voqealar uchun be going to ishlatamiz.

usage.text: Oldindan o'ylab qo'yilgan rejalar va niyatlar uchun.

example.en: We are going to visit our grandparents this weekend.
example.uz: Biz bu dam olish kunlari buvijonimnikiga bormoqchimiz.

usage.text: Hozirgi ko'rib turgan dalillarimizga qarab sodir bo'ladigan voqealar uchun.

example.en: Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain.
example.uz: Anavi qora bulutlarga qarang! Yomg'ir yog'moqchi.

example.en: I am going to buy a new car.

structure.formula: Subject + am/is/are + not + going to + V1

example.en: He isn't going to watch TV tonight.
example.uz: U bugun kechqurun televizor ko'rmoqchi emas.

example.en: Are you going to travel this summer?

structure.formula: Yes, subject + am/is/are / No, subject + 'm not / isn't / aren't

example.en: Yes, I am. / No, she isn't.

tip: Eslatma: 'be' fe'lini (am/is/are) egaga moslab o'zgartirishni unutmang!

name: First conditional
name_uz: Birinchi shart ergash gap: First conditional
summary: Hozir yoki kelajakda sodir bo'lish ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan shartli vaziyatlar va ularning natijalarini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: Real va bajarilishi mumkin bo'lgan shartlarni bildirish uchun.

example.en: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
If it rains, we will stay at home.

structure.formula: If + Present Simple, Subject + will + V1

example.en: If I have time, I will help you.
example.uz: Agar vaqtim bo'lsa, senga yordam beraman.

structure.formula: If + don't/doesn't + V1, Subject + won't + V1

example.en: If she doesn't hurry, she will miss the bus.
example.uz: Agar u shoshilmasa, avtobusdan qolib ketadi.

structure.formula: Will + subject + V1 + if + Present Simple?

example.en: What will you do if you win the competition?
example.uz: Agar musobaqada yutib chiqsang, nima qilasan?

structure.formula: Yes, I will / No, I won't

tip: Eslatma: 'If' so'zi kelgan qismda HECH QACHON 'will' ishlatilmaydi! 'If'dan keyin doim Present Simple keladi.
